integrity: The argument uses the source’s exact scalar endemic-equilibrium reduction and threshold definitions, proves strict parameter monotonicity, and factors the scalar equation at \(R_0=1\), \(\beta_2=\beta_2^\ast\). Exact-rational replay checks the algebra on independent rational parameter sets. Exact-title, DOI, threshold-alias, broader reinfection-model, semantic-database, correction/erratum, and local-ledger searches found no covering statement. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem excludes positive endemic equilibria for the published SEIRV system under \(0<\sigma\le1\), \(R_0\le1\), and \(\beta_2\le\beta_2^\ast\). It does not prove global convergence to the disease-free equilibrium, exclude non-equilibrium invariant sets, or cover extensions of the model.
title: The reinfection threshold globally excludes subcritical endemic equilibria
